verses.1: And I saw another sign in the heavens, which was great and marvelous. It consisted of seven angels, each with seven wounds on their bodies. It was because in those wounds was fulfilled God’s wrath.
verses.2: And we saw how the sea was filled with a blue-colored liquid. The winners were those who were able to defeat the monster and its image. They were also those whose names appeared in the list of winners. They all carried instruments made by God.
verses.3: And they rejoice in the joy of Moses, the servant of God. They also rejoice in the joy of the ram. “Great and marvelous are your works, O Lord, God Almighty! Your paths are righteous and true, O King of ages!”
verses.4: Do you not fear, Lord? Do you not rejoice at the glory of your name, because you are the only one who is worthy? That all nations will come and worship before you, that your rights have been revealed.
verses.5: And after that, I saw that the stage of the testimony was revealed in the heavens.
verses.6: And the seven angels who carried the seven wounds from the temple came out, wearing pure, bright linen garments, and their bodies were covered with gold.
verses.7: And from among the four animals, he gave to the seven messengers seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of the living God, for the ages to come.
verses.8: And the ark was filled with the smoke from the glory of God and from His power. No one could enter the ark until the seven signs of the seven angels were completed.
